gaps.route: POST /api/hooks/run (successful dispatch of an enabled hook)
gaps.reason: A live run of a built-in pre_tool hook can block subsequent tool fixtures. Only the missing-selector 400 and unknown-hook 404 are captured. fire is the same handler.
Suggestions are derived from the user's question history. The seeded sandbox has no chat history that matches an intent rule, so the list is empty and only the unknown-id 404 is captured.
A live execution goes through the async run executor and may call the LLM. Only dry-run (the SPA default) is captured.

HTTP cannot create a change proposal through the governor (agent_worker_seam is KEEP_WORKER and gated on LATTICEAI_AGENT_TOOL_SEAM). Seeding posts a review item with the same payload shape ChangeProposalService writes, which is what approve/409 actually consume.

The change_proposals router catches ProposalConflictError as ValueError and answers 400 with a string detail. The structured 409 (error=change_proposal_conflict, rebase_hint) is only on POST /automation/reviews/{id}/approve. Both oracles are captured. VS Code keys on 409 for this path; that is a pre-existing client/oracle mismatch, not rewritten.
